title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Amphitheatre on 1982-07-28
source: source: aud cassette master; taped by Doug Lamarre; nak 300’s > sony d5m, fob; maxell mx90’s, dolby b; nakamichi dragon/b > benchmark ADC1 24/96 > tascam HD-P2,compact flash > mac > adobe audition > fission > 16/44.1 > xACT flac; transferred and seeded by Rob Berger

ai_review.summary: A solid recording captured in pouring rain that still delivers a zesty first set with attentive playing.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its lively, listening band and an especially tasty first set despite the challenges of a rainy outdoor environment. Reviewers note the rain‑filled ambience but feel it adds character rather than detracting from enjoyment, earning a respectable four‑star rating.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review highlights strong musical performance and tolerable recording conditions; limited data leads to medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded in pouring rain, which adds ambient noise but does not overwhelm the mix; overall listening experience remains pleasant.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as zesty and engaging; reviewer also enjoys the second set though no specifics are given.
